concerns.text: The performance‑retention metric (SC‑001) is defined inconsistently and circularly. In the plan it is described as “≥ 80 % of the baseline performance gain is retained”, implying comparison of the Student‑Only gain against the gain of the dual‑model SDAR over the GRPO baseline. However, in research.md the concrete formula is given as (Success_Student − Success_Baseline) / Success_Baseline ≥ 0.80, which measures the relative improvement of Student‑Only over the SDAR baseline, not the retention of the *baseline* gain. This definition makes the claim either undefined (if Baseline = Student) or trivially unrelated to the intended hypothesis, rendering the validation non‑independent and effectively tautological. The metric should instead be (Success_Student − Success_GRPO) / (Success_Baseline − Success_GRPO) ≥ 0.80, i.e., the proportion of the original SDAR improvement over GRPO that the Student‑Only variant preserves.
